title: DNA Extraction with Zymo Quick-DNA™ Fungal/Bacterial Miniprep Kit
author: Zhenyu Shen

steps.title: Prepare colony or broth sample
steps.instruction: If using colonies, plates may be stored at 2 °C–8 °C for up to two weeks before extraction; add 750 µL BashingBead Buffer to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube, then transfer one or several pure colonies (or a small agar piece if colonies are difficult to pick) with a sterile inoculation loop into the tube. If using broth, centrifuge 1 mL culture at 6,000 × g for 10 min in a microcentrifuge tube, discard the supernatant, retain the pellet (store at –25 °C to –15 °C if extraction is delayed), resuspend the pellet in 750 µL BashingBead Buffer and transfer the suspension to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube.

steps.title: Bead‑beat lysate
steps.instruction: Secure the lysis tube in a bead beater (e.g., vortex mixer with a horizontal tube holder) and homogenize at maximum speed for 5 min. Do not discard the tube. If DNA extraction fails due to insufficient bead beating, repeat the bead‑beating step for up to 20 min before proceeding.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysis tube at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Bind DNA to filter
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the supernatant into a Zymo‑Spin‱ III‑F Filter placed in a collection tube and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Add Genomic Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Discard the filter, add 600 µL Genomic Lysis Buffer to the flow‑through, and mix thoroughly by pipetting.

steps.title: Load mixture onto column
steps.instruction: Load the entire 800 µL mixture onto a Zymo‑Spin‱ IICR Column in a new collection tube and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Pre‑wash column
steps.instruction: Place the IICR Column into a fresh collection tube (discard the previous tube), add 200 µL DNA Pre‑Wash Buffer, and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: g‑DNA wash column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL g‑DNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 35–100 µL DNA Elution Buffer directly onto the column matrix, and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min to collect the eluted DNA.
